target_customer: Travelers booking professionally managed vacation rentals, and property managers distributing inventory
problem: Peer to peer rentals carried quality risks. VaycayHero listed only vetted professionally managed properties and offered property managers dynamic pricing and distribution.
business_model: Marketplace commission on bookings, plus distribution hub for managers

founders.name: Amitav Chakravartty
founders.background_notes: Self reported on YC page as experienced in SaaS platforms, scaling and payments.

exit.reason: Service was suspended on 31 January 2017, then RedAwning bought the assets and some team members.

technical_complexity.rationale: Marketplace with dynamic pricing and property manager inventory integrations; standard engineering with some hard integration work.

defensibility.rationale: Inventory came from property managers who also listed on larger platforms, so supply and demand were easy to switch.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large platforms dominated demand; VaycayHero suspended service in January 2017 and sold assets to RedAwning.

market_need_then: Vacation rentals were a large and growing category and managers wanted distribution, but no dated demand figures specific to managed inventory were found.

branding.name_origin: The company started as Zaranga and was renamed VaycayHero in 2013 after Priceline Group objected to its name your own price wording, per a PhocusWire summary.
branding.domain_note: Used vaycayhero.com; it now redirects to a domain for sale page.

rebrands.why: Reportedly pressure from Priceline Group over name your own price terminology (one outlet; the date is inconsistent).

brand_strength.rationale: Playful but unusual spelling and little press beyond trade coverage of funding and the sale.

pivots.from: Zaranga, name your own price vacation rentals
pivots.to: VaycayHero, marketplace of vetted professionally managed rentals
pivots.why: Priceline objected to the pricing terminology per PhocusWire; later added a distribution hub

outcome_analysis: VaycayHero began as Zaranga with name your own price pricing, renamed in 2013 and positioned on vetted managed rentals against Airbnb and Vrbo. It raised about 2.8M in seed funding in December 2014, served more than 15,000 guests by late 2014, but suspended service on 31 January 2017 and sold its assets to RedAwning in March 2017. The shutdown cause was not stated publicly beyond the suspension, so the failure factors are inferred from the small raise and dominant rivals.
notes: Seed 2.8M per a VentureBeat summary via Seedtable; another source says 3M; not cross-checked on a primary source because PhocusWire article fetch returned 403. Total raised ranges 2.9M to 4M (PhocusWire says over 4M). Earlier 2013 seed from MicroVentures mentioned by Wellfound, not recorded. YC page says founded 2011; search results name Anirban Bardalaye as another cofounder, not on YC page so not listed. Education and prior employers not found. No competitor sources dated near 2013 found.
